```{r}
# STEP 0 - Output setup

root_out <- "../output"
dir_glm_pois <- file.path(root_out, "GLM_Poisson")

if (!dir.exists(dir_glm_pois)) {
  dir.create(dir_glm_pois, recursive = TRUE)
}

out_file <- file.path(dir_glm_pois, "Poisson_Modeling_Report.txt")

while (sink.number() > 0) sink()
sink(out_file)

cat("=========================================\n")
cat("GLM POISSON MODELING REPORT\n")

cat("=========================================\n\n")
 
```

```{r}
# STEP 1 - Clean Data Loading 

# 1.1 Load data
df_clean <- read.csv("../data/processed/listings_cleaned.csv",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 1.2 Convert relevant variables to factor
df_clean$room_type <- as.factor(df_clean$room_type)
df_clean$property_type <- as.factor(df_clean$property_type)
df_clean$property_type <- relevel(df_clean$property_type, ref = "Apartment")
df_clean$neighbourhood_cleansed <- as.factor(df_clean$neighbourhood_cleansed)
df_clean$instant_bookable <- as.factor(df_clean$instant_bookable)
df_clean$cancellation_policy <- as.factor(df_clean$cancellation_policy)
df_clean$host_is_superhost <- as.factor(df_clean$host_is_superhost)
df_clean$host_identity_verified <- as.factor(df_clean$host_identity_verified)

```

```{r}
# STEP 2 - Poisson: Kitchen Model

cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 2 - Poisson (Kitchen Model)\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

model_pois_kitchen <- glm(
  number_of_reviews ~
    log_price + extra_people + guests_included +
    room_type + accommodates + bedrooms + bathrooms + beds +
    property_type + neighbourhood_cleansed +
    host_is_superhost + host_response_rate + host_acceptance_rate +
    host_identity_verified + minimum_nights + instant_bookable +
    cancellation_policy + review_scores_rating +
    log_host_listings_count + amenities_count + host_response_time_ord +
    distance_to_center_km +
    offset(log(months_active)),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = df_clean
)

summary(model_pois_kitchen)

```

```{r}
# STEP 3 - Poisson: Clean Model

cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 3 - Poisson (Clean Model)\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

model_pois_clean <- glm(
  number_of_reviews ~
    log_price + accommodates + room_type + property_type +
    distance_to_center_km + neighbourhood_cleansed +
    amenities_count + minimum_nights + instant_bookable +
    host_is_superhost + host_response_rate +
    log_host_listings_count +
    offset(log(months_active)),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = df_clean
)

summary(model_pois_clean)

```

```{r}
# STEP 4 - Poisson: Same-sample comparison + clustering + overdispersion
library(dplyr)

cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 4 - Poisson Comparison & Diagnostics\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

# 4.1 Build same-sample dataset for BOTH Poisson models (include host_id for clustering)
vars_needed <- unique(c(
  all.vars(formula(model_pois_kitchen)),
  all.vars(formula(model_pois_clean)),
  "host_id"
))

df_pois_same <- df_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars_needed)) %>%
  na.omit()

# 4.2 Refit both models on the same sample
model_pois_kitchen_same <- glm(
  formula(model_pois_kitchen),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = df_pois_same
)

model_pois_clean_same <- glm(
  formula(model_pois_clean),
  family = poisson(link = "log"),
  data = df_pois_same
)

cat("\n--- Same-sample size ---\n")
cat("N (same sample):", nrow(df_pois_same), "\n")

# 4.3 AIC comparison
cat("\n--- AIC Comparison (Poisson, same sample) ---\n")
print(AIC(model_pois_kitchen_same, model_pois_clean_same))

# 4.4 Likelihood Ratio Test
cat("\n--- Likelihood Ratio Test (Poisson, same sample) ---\n")
cat("NOTE: LRT is valid only if Clean is nested within Kitchen.\n\n")
print(anova(model_pois_clean_same, model_pois_kitchen_same, test = "Chisq"))

# 4.5 Cluster-robust SE (host level)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

cat("\n--- Cluster-robust SE (host_id) : Kitchen ---\n")
vcov_kitchen_host <- vcovCL(model_pois_kitchen_same,
                            cluster = df_pois_same$host_id)
print(coeftest(model_pois_kitchen_same, vcov = vcov_kitchen_host))

cat("\n--- Cluster-robust SE (host_id) : Clean ---\n")
vcov_clean_host <- vcovCL(model_pois_clean_same,
                          cluster = df_pois_same$host_id)
print(coeftest(model_pois_clean_same, vcov = vcov_clean_host))

# 4.6 Overdispersion (Pearson dispersion)
dispersion_kitchen <- sum(residuals(model_pois_kitchen_same, type = "pearson")^2) /
                      model_pois_kitchen_same$df.residual

dispersion_clean <- sum(residuals(model_pois_clean_same, type = "pearson")^2) /
                    model_pois_clean_same$df.residual

cat("\n--- Dispersion (Pearson) ---\n")
cat("Kitchen (same sample):", dispersion_kitchen, "\n")
cat("Clean   (same sample):", dispersion_clean, "\n")

cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("END OF POISSON MODELING\n")
cat("Report saved to:\n")
cat(out_file, "\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

while (sink.number() > 0) sink()

```

```{r}
# STEP 5 - IRR Stability Graph (Kitchen vs Clean, same sample)

cat("\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 5 - IRR Stability Graph\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

# Core drivers for slide (NO rating)
core_vars <- c(
  "log_price",
  "accommodates",
  "distance_to_center_km",
  "instant_bookable1",
  "host_is_superhost1"
)

# Extract coefficients from same-sample models
b_kitchen <- coef(model_pois_kitchen_same)
b_clean   <- coef(model_pois_clean_same)

# Helper: return coefficient if exists, else NA
get_coef <- function(b, term) {
  if (term %in% names(b)) as.numeric(b[term]) else NA_real_
}

# Build table and convert to IRR
df_irr <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    term = core_vars,
    beta = sapply(core_vars, function(t) get_coef(b_kitchen, t)),
    model = "Kitchen"
  ),
  tibble(
    term = core_vars,
    beta = sapply(core_vars, function(t) get_coef(b_clean, t)),
    model = "Simplified"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    irr = exp(beta),
    label = case_when(
      term == "log_price" ~ "log_price",
      term == "accommodates" ~ "accommodates",
      term == "distance_to_center_km" ~ "distance_to_center_km",
      term == "instant_bookable1" ~ "instant_bookable",
      term == "host_is_superhost1" ~ "superhost",
      TRUE ~ term
    ),
    label = factor(label, levels = c("log_price","accommodates","distance_to_center_km","instant_bookable","superhost"))
  )

# Plot IRR
p_stability_irr <- ggplot(df_irr, aes(x = label, y = irr, group = model, color = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), na.rm = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "IRR Stability (Poisson, Same Sample)",
    subtitle = "Kitchen vs Simplified (core drivers)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Incidence Rate Ratio (IRR = exp(β))"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1))

# Save for slides
plot_file <- file.path(dir_glm_pois, "Poisson_IRR_Stability_Core.png")
ggsave(plot_file, p_stability_irr, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)

cat("Saved IRR stability plot to:\n", plot_file, "\n")

# Sanity print
cat("\n--- IRR table used for plot ---\n")
print(df_irr %>% select(model, term, beta, irr))
```
